Chapter 709: Chapter 12 Dimensionality Reduction (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 709: Chapter 12 Dimensionality Reduction (Please Subscribe)_3

“`

If there are ties of kinship, it is definitely best to live as long as possible to protect the clan for a longer time.

Tuoba Ancient God, with no relatives or friends, is a unique being in the cosmic starry skies, which is why he dared to make such a bold request to Lin Yuan.

“My current strength is far from being a match for Tuoba Ancient God,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Tuoba Ancient God was of the fifth tier of Eleventh-Rank, while Lin Yuan was currently only comparable to a second-tier Eleventh-Rank, with no comparability in strength between them.

...

The six tiers of Eleventh-Rank life each have a massive gap in strength.

“Give me another thousand years…” Lin Yuan bore a killing intent towards Tuoba Ancient God, but also knew it was not realistic.

Just based on his rate of growth, he estimated it would be possible in another one or two thousand years.

Of course, that was just a possibility. With the strength of Tuoba Ancient God, Lin Yuan estimated he would have to become a Supreme Being to be assured of killing the other.

…

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit personally rushed over.

At the same time, other Tier 10 Grade A Evolvers arrived.

“You have only a hundred years,”

“In a hundred years, try to comprehend this segment of aurora as much as possible.”

The figure of Xia Qin Supreme Being appeared, and without any unnecessary words, a segment of colorful, splendid aurora floated in the air.

According to the agreement with the other eight Supreme Beings of human civilization, this aurora would stay in each Evolution Tower for a hundred years.

After nine hundred years, it would be the main ingredient in forging an ultimate weapon.

At that time, the potency of the aurora would be condensed, and it would be difficult to comprehend any further.

“Is this the cosmic aurora that easily shattered a large alien battlefield?” Lin Yuan’s gaze fell on the aurora for the first time.

[Your perception defies the heavens, observing the unknown aurora, your understanding of the rules of light deepens…]

…

[Your perception defies the heavens, observing the unknown aurora, your understanding of the rules of cause and effect deepens…]

…

[Your perception defies the heavens, observing the unknown aurora, your understanding of Space Rules deepens…]

…

It was only a single breath.

Lin Yuan had already comprehended dozens of rule fluctuations from this segment of aurora, among which the rules of light and cause and effect were the most intense.

“Rules of light…”

Lin Yuan vaguely felt that the rules of light within the aurora were not normal, they must have fused with other rules, otherwise, they could not be this powerful.

And the rules of cause and effect, these rules are easy to start with but extremely hard to master in depth, and Lin Yuan’s understanding of them was not very high due to his lack of full concentration.

“The remaining six pillar-level rules on the black planet, two of which involve the rules of cause and effect. Perhaps with the help of this aurora, I could meet the requirements in the understanding of the rules of cause and effect?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Though the rules of cause and effect are not Pillar-level Fusion Rules, they are nonetheless more important than most, and their comprehension difficulty exceeds most pillar rules.

And Pillar-level Fusion Rules that encompass the rules of cause and effect are extremely peculiar and unpredictable.

…

Battlefield A098 of Different Races.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, above his head was an Eternal Spatial Rift spanning a thousand miles, emitting slow spatial fluctuations.

It was at this moment—

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted subtly.

“`

“This feeling?”

Lin Yuan suddenly looked up, gazing at the Eternal Spatial Rift above his head.

In a vague sense,

he felt that an unknown change had occurred within this Eternal Spatial Rift.

The next moment,

under Lin Yuan’s watchful eyes,

a piece of ‘White Paper’ squeezed in.

The ‘White Paper’ had only length and width, with no concept of ‘thickness,’ giving a very contradictory impression.

“White Paper?” Lin Yuan stared intently at the piece of white paper, which made his scalp tingle somewhat.

Rustle rustle.

After the White Paper squeezed into the universe, it instantly penetrated the entire Large Alien Battlefield.

However, the Large Alien Battlefield did not shatter; instead, some sort of dimensional collapse occurred, losing the concept of spatial volume. In just an instant, the Large Alien Battlefield, nearly a thousand light-years across, was compressed into a painting scroll, then assimilated into the ‘White Paper.’

Buzz.

The White Paper continued to fly towards the Cosmic Starry Sky.

Wherever it went, all matter was compressed, including space itself, forming painting scrolls that fused into the ‘White Paper.’

“What is this?”

A towering figure staggered back a few steps, staring incredulously at the rapidly receding ‘White Paper.’

He was a Twelfth Rank Ultimate; a moment of inattention had also sucked him into the ‘White Paper,’ but as a being who stepped out of the River of Time, the White Paper’s dimensional reduction ability couldn’t completely suppress him, and that was how he escaped.

Only,

he had escaped,

but countless lives on Battlefield A098, including those Eleventh Rank Powerhouses, had all fallen into the ‘White Paper.’

Even space itself swiftly collapsed as if a part of it was cut out of thin air.

“The Taiyuan Relic, this direction is towards the Taiyuan Relic.”

One Supreme Being after another appeared, all staring solemnly at the departing ‘White Paper.’

“What exactly has happened to the Taiyuan Relic?” The single-horned Supreme Being had a grave expression. Fifty or sixty years ago, the Cosmic Aurora also came from the Taiyuan Relic.

Now, this eerie ‘White Paper’ had likewise come from the direction of the Taiyuan Relic.

This made them speculate whether the Taiyuan Relic had undergone some unpredictable change.

“Gentlemen, let’s not worry about the Taiyuan Relic for now,”

“If we let that ‘White Paper’ continue to fly, one ten-thousandth of our universe will be completely dimensionally reduced.”

One Supreme Being spoke up.

Although the White Paper’s dimensional reduction effect was ineffective against Supreme Beings, the numerous lives within their races were all within the scope of the reduction.

“Let’s join forces.”

“Together, we can hold that ‘White Paper’ in place.”

“Right, we can’t let it keep flying around recklessly.”

The Supreme Beings quickly decided and began to take action, slowly restricting the White Paper’s movement with their spacetime might.

Soon,

the flight speed of the ‘White Paper’ slowed down.

Finally, it stopped beneath a certain expanse of the starry sky.

The ‘White Paper’ slowly unfolded, revealing a painting scroll exuding a mysterious aura before the Supreme Beings.
